name: AI Inbox Triage Workflow
summary: Concept: classify incoming enquiries and prepare a response for human review.
challenge: Manual inbox sorting can delay useful enquiries and bury the context needed to reply.
approach: Proposed flow: receive an enquiry through a webhook, remove unnecessary personal data, classify it with a local model, validate the structured result, and queue a draft for human approval. No message is sent automatically.
features: Local-model classification with a fallback queue
description: Illustrative workflow design concept using sample data. This is not a deployed product or client case study.
technologies: Proposed: Ollama, ASP.NET Core, C#, .NET 8 / .NET 9, Hangfire, SQL Server
